_what_this_is: The maintainer's permission, transcribed. It is an INPUT to scripts/autoinit/issue_continuation_b_authorization.py, never produced by it: a one-use decision that lived only in executable source would go stale silently and still read as though it applied. Every identity, hash, digest and commit is derived by the issuer; this document asserts none of them.
